title: Anduril Founder Palmer Luckey Comments on Emergency Prep
excerpt: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey recently stated that Americans ought to keep three days of essential supplies on hand.
body_html:
During a recent statement, Anduril founder Palmer Luckey addressed the topic of emergency preparedness. While not denying that he is a prepper, he recommended that Americans maintain a minimum three-day supply of food, water, and medicine.

Luckey suggested that having these basic provisions readily available is a sensible precaution for unexpected situations. The defense technology founder shared this perspective on Wednesday.
